## Ports of reconstructed source

- [**2 Ship 2 Harkinian: a native Majora’s Mask port built on the decompilation**](https://github.com/2ship2harkinian/2ship2harkinian) - Builds native Windows, Linux and macOS versions of The Legend of Zelda: Majora’s Mask from an adapted copy of the zeldaret/mm decompilation, with libultraship reimplementing N64 SDK functions. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/2ship2harkinian-mm-port-case/)</sub>
- [**358/2 Days for Android: porting Kingdom Hearts to dual-screen devices**](https://github.com/sonofskywalker3/khdays-358-android) - 358/2 Days for Android ports Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days to Android using the upstream khdays-port and its decompiled C game code. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/khdays-358-android-case/)</sub>
- [**3D Pinball — Space Cadet: a Nintendo DS port of the decompilation**](https://github.com/headshot2017/3dpinball-nds) - 3dpinball-nds adapts the Space Cadet Pinball decompilation into a Nintendo DS port built with BlocksDS. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/3dpinball-nds-case/)</sub>
- [**3SX: a native Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike port continuing the PS2 decompilation**](https://github.com/crowded-street/3sx) - Builds Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike as native C for Windows, macOS and Linux, continuing the 3s-decomp PS2 decompilation, with SDL3 for video, input and audio and GekkoNet for rollback netplay. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/3sx-third-strike-native-port-case/)</sub>
- [**9mm Vita: rehosting 9mm HD Android on PS Vita**](https://github.com/iwannagooutside/9mm-vita) - 9mm Vita ports 9mm HD Android to PS Vita by loading the user's ARMv7 game executable into memory. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/9mm-vita-case/)</sub>
- [**Airborne Ranger: lifting a DOS game into a C port**](https://github.com/xor2003/airborn-ranger) - Airborne Ranger ports the 1987 DOS game to C by lifting AR.EXE and its TANDYSND.EXE overlay with a masm2c-style translator, then hand-checking the output against the reference binaries. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/airborne-ranger-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Animal Crossing gcNX: a native Switch port of the GameCube decompilation**](https://github.com/digdat0/ACGC-Switch-Port) - Animal Crossing gcNX ports the decompiled GameCube game to Nintendo Switch by compiling its code for ARM and translating GX graphics to OpenGL ES. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/animal-crossing-gcnx-case/)</sub>
- [**Animal Crossing: a native PC port of the GameCube decompilation**](https://github.com/flyngmt/ACGC-PC-Port) - Runs Animal Crossing’s decompiled GameCube C code natively on 32-bit x86, replacing the GX graphics API with an OpenGL 3.3 translation layer and console services with SDL2-based platform code. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/animal-crossing-pc-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Animal Crossing: Wild World: a native PC port of the decompilation**](https://github.com/7ucina/acww-decomp) - Animal Crossing: Wild World, native compiles decompiled code from the USA Rev 1 Nintendo DS game into a PC program. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/animal-crossing-wild-world-native-case/)</sub>
- [**Another World JS: a browser port interpreting the game's bytecode**](https://github.com/cyxx/another_js) - Another World JS ports Another World to an HTML5 browser runtime by implementing its 26 game bytecode opcodes in JavaScript. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/another-world-js-case/)</sub>
- [**Another World: a Commander X16 port of the original virtual machine**](https://github.com/cosmicr/anotherx16) - Another World is ported to Commander X16 in 65C02 assembly, using data files from the user's MS-DOS game copy. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/another-world-commander-x16-case/)</sub>

- [**Arcanum Community Edition: rebuilding Arcanum for modern systems**](https://github.com/alexbatalov/arcanum-ce) - Arcanum Community Edition rebuilds Arcanum as a replacement executable for modern operating systems while using data from the player's game installation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/arcanum-community-edition-case/)</sub>
